scope: One MAE paper and repository; three planning runs per strategy; one execution smoke test.

workflow_checks: persisted plan recovered after fresh application lifespan
only selected checkpoints and custom question executed
duplicate execution submission reused existing job
partial investigation failure preserved in completed report

limitations: No independent holdout and no statistical significance claim.
Keyword candidates are not semantic coverage scores; no independently annotated coverage result is reported.
Agent-1 accepted points came from one-shot fallback; they do not demonstrate autonomous planning quality.
Execution validates the workflow, not correctness of every generated finding.
Agent read repeatedly and proposed late; these runs do not demonstrate an improvement over one-shot planning.
